TRAP (2026-06-17): cargo-ci gate has timeout_seconds=300 (gates.json:53). On a hipcc host cargo-ci.sh uses --all-features (incl hip) and builds BOTH dev (check+clippy) and release (test) profiles. A from-scratch build exceeds 5 min -> jit kills the checker -> 'Error, exit code None' (NOT a real test failure, NOT only OOM; capping -j made it slower/worse). FIX: pre-warm the full cache directly (cargo check --all-features; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features; cargo nextest --all-features --release --no-run) BEFORE running the gate, so the gate's incremental re-run fits in 300s. Do NOT change the gate timeout (forbidden gate modification). Run gates serially; never concurrent with another build (rust-analyzer alone holds ~5.4GB; ~12Gi free).
